summary: Allow Swift and TypeScript st3 clients to inject trace context through an optional callback

replay.detail: SDK-only change; no daemon claim replay or history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Swift and TypeScript clients expose an optional trace-context callback. Existing callers without the callback retain their behavior; no daemon protocol or harness changes are required.

downtime.detail: SDK-only change requires no daemon restart or service interruption.

manual.detail: No mandatory migration or configuration change. Applications may opt into trace propagation by supplying the callback.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions. Applications can omit the callback or revert the SDK update.
